newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: 50 dead, 30 survivors from hijacked Ethiopia plane.
newsitem.headline: 50 dead, 30 survivors from hijacked Ethiopia plane.

text.p: Ethiopian Airlines said 50 people were confirmed dead and 30 survived out of the 175 people aboard its hijacked Boeing 767 that came down in the sea near the Comoro Islands on Saturday.
The captain and one crew member were among the survivors, it added. The airline said the plane split in two when it ditched while trying to land at Moroni airport after it ran out of fuel.
The fuselage was seen floating in the sea while the rear part has submerged, the airline added.
The airline said an investigating team left Addis Ababa for Moroni on Saturday evening.
